docs.title: 🧬 Karcytics Synthetic Biology
docs.text: Welcome to the Synthetic Biology Workspace documentation — a Karcytics plugin for designing, validating, and simulating biological logic gates and synthetic genetic circuits.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
This module bridges the gap between computer science and biology by providing tools to:

  • Design biological logic gates (AND, OR, NOT) from standardized genetic parts
  • Validate circuit orthogonality to prevent signal crosstalk
  • Simulate circuit kinetics using ODE-based models with real biochemical parameters
  • Visualize protein concentrations over time with oscilloscope-style graphs

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
The plugin follows Karcytics's standard plugin architecture, running as an isolated process (process_model = "isolated") with its own PyQt6 UI daemon:

Layer Directory Purpose Analysis src/karcytics_plugins/synthetic_biology/analysis/ Domain model, state, circuit engine, simulation (no PyQt6 imports) UI src/karcytics_plugins/synthetic_biology/ui/ PyQt6 widgets, panels, canvas Tests tests/ Unit tests
